purpose: Prevent engineering/mechanism worlds from being mislabeled as realistic Japanese-keirin generators while preserving their value as adversarial test rigs, and define a separate evidence path for reality-calibrated worlds.

REALITY_CALIBRATED_WORLD_FAMILY.purpose: Represent only structures and parameter ranges supported by official rules, decision-time admissible PRE evidence, provenance-tracked empirical calibration, or explicitly labeled sensitivity assumptions.

source_classes.OFFICIAL_RULE: Immutable or currently authoritative competition/race rule from KEIRIN/JKA official material.
source_classes.OFFICIAL_MASTER: Official venue/bank or stable master data with version/provenance.
source_classes.PRE_EMPIRICAL_AUTHORIZED: Lawfully held point-in-time PRE observations with timestamp/provenance and no result leakage.
source_classes.BURNED_OUTCOME_AWARE: Explicitly outcome-aware development/calibration evidence that is permanently ineligible as untouched validation.
source_classes.EXTERNAL_AGGREGATE: Admissible aggregate empirical statistic with source/provenance and no protected-record opening.
source_classes.ASSUMPTION_RANGE: Explicit sensitivity range when reality calibration is unavailable; never presented as observed reality.
source_classes.ENGINEERING_FIXTURE: Deliberately artificial mechanism used only for testing implementation/failure behavior.

prohibited_calibration_sources: candidate win/loss result used to choose truth mechanism
post-race reconstructed line labeled as PRE
current profile snapshot backfilled into historical races without point-in-time proof
cross_family_rules: Engineering-world PASS may generate a hypothesis but may not promote that hypothesis as reality evidence.
Reality-world design may borrow official invariants from engineering schemas but must not inherit uncalibrated engineering frequencies/effect sizes by default.
W0-W4 must not be rewritten merely to make them appear realistic; preserve their adversarial/mechanical purpose.
A reality-oriented model comparison requires a separately governed, prespecified reality-calibrated world version and cannot use the current PEER/N1 engineering wins as a success criterion.
Actual real-data validation remains a separate later gate even after a reality-calibrated simulator exists.
